tracks.name: lean
tracks.description: Prove RISC-V bytecode equivalent to the fixed Pancake EVM guest in Lean, and minimize the certified execution step bound K. The initial submission claims infinity.
tracks.hardware: Official runs: Linux guest with systemd 257+ and Landlock ABI 3+, up to 30 Lean processes, 112 GiB memory cap per build unit, no verifier time limit (23-hour job timeout). The initial submission takes hours to build and writes about 120 GB of build output. Use a case-sensitive file system (paths differ only by case).
